sections.heading: Main Story
items: The campaign leads you through Tortuga and surrounding biomes, introducing combat, sailing, and crafting in stages.
Key early quests unlock the first ship, the Alchemy Table, and access to the Foothills Island.
Boss quests gate biomes. Defeat the local boss to unlock the next region and its resources.

sections.heading: Side Quests
items: Side quests reward gear, recipes, and reputation with factions.
Some side quests are missable if you progress the main story too far. Talk to every named NPC in Tortuga.
Treasure maps and riddles lead to buried chests; bring a shovel and expect a fight.

sections.heading: Faction & Reputation
items: Factions offer unique vendors and quest lines. Reputation is earned by completing their quests and selling contraband.
Higher reputation unlocks better gear recipes and discounted prices.
